name: Ruggable Cyrus Beige Ivory Tufted All-in-One Rug, 8x10

dimensions.raw: 8x10 (the size shown with the $499.00 price); Pile Height: 7 mm (medium); Material: 100% polyester
dimensions.source: the listing's rows, read in Chrome 2026-10-26 (the size as sold; a rug: the short side is w only by convention here, placed by rotation)

notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26: "Relatives are trying to tell my wife that rugs are necessary ... Let's show her ruggables / washable rugs. Start with ikea first, but also alternatives that are low pile / machine washable / easily vacuumable without getting stuck"; "rugs that fit CORRECTLY for the dining room, living room, master bedroom and kids room"; "Make sure COLOR is appropriate for the floor and furniture". Ruggable's best seller, read on ruggable.com (no photo: the host is off the image allowlist; a screenshot was looked at): a one-piece tufted washable rug with a built-in non-slip backing and a waterproof barrier, "home machine washable up to 8'x10'", 7 mm medium pile; Ruggable's original 2-piece Flatwoven system is 2 mm (~1/16") low pile on a separate pad. Its page: "Robot vacuums are not recommended, as they may damage rug edges or corners", which fails Andrew's vacuum test. Beige and ivory bordered Persian pattern; 9 colors. Made to order, free shipping in 1 to 2 weeks. $499.00 for the 8x10; 4 to 5 times the printed washable rugs on Amazon.
